modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Carry-on allowance varies with the fare purchased; some fares include no carry-on or checked baggage.

personal_item.value: Each adult or child passenger may bring one personal item weighing up to 3kg / 7lbs; it must fit under the seat in front of you.

carryon_weight.value: Where the fare includes a carry-on: one carry-on bag up to 6kg / 13lbs, in addition to the personal item. Where it does not, carry-on bags must be checked in at the airport and fees apply. An additional $50 fee applies if your allowance is exceeded.
carryon_weight.notes: The cabin-bag size figures on this page did not survive capture, so no dimensions are published.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: All charges are one way. These rules apply to WINAIR-operated flights.

size_weight.value: Max weight 50 lbs / 23 kg and max dimension (L+W+H) 62 inches / 157cm per bag. Infants are allowed one piece at 10 kg. Bags between 23 kg and 32 kg may be accepted on space availability only, for an overweight charge.

fees_by_fare.value: Saver or Lite fare families (bags of 23 kg or less), online / airport: flights to/from SAB/EUX and between AUA-CUR and BON-CUR, 1st bag $15 / $25, 2nd $45 / $55, 3rd $95 / $105; other flights, 1st bag $30 / $40, 2nd $60 / $70, 3rd $110 / $120. Prime or Value fare families include the 1st bag and pay the same 2nd- and 3rd-bag fees.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: These are standards published by the carrier for delays and cancellations. On codeshares or interline itineraries, the operating carrier is responsible.

care.value: When a flight is delayed or cancelled within carrier control, passengers are entitled to meals, refreshments, communication access, and hotel accommodation with transport for overnight delays.

rebooking_refund.value: For disruptions within carrier control, the airline rebooks passengers on the next available flight or provides a full refund for unused flight segments if delayed by 3 hours or more.

compensation.value: Statutory or policy compensation applies for cancellations or long delays within carrier control according to applicable aviation passenger rights regulations.
